name: Bender JCC of Greater Washington Mah Jongg
description: Mah jongg courses (beginner, intermediate, advanced intermediate) and open play at the Bender JCC. Beginner course: "players learn the basic rules of American Mah Jongg, including tile identification, the Charleston, how to read the National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) card, and how to form a hand." Ages 18+.
schedule: Multi-week courses Mon/Tue/Wed; Open Play Fridays Jan 8-Feb 26 2027 10:00 AM-12:00 PM (member $100 / non-member $110, per page)

name: Mah Jongg at the Library (Quince Orchard Library)
description: Free drop-in mah jongg at Quince Orchard Library (Gaithersburg, Montgomery County Public Libraries). Page: "We play American Mah Jongg according to National Mah Jongg League rules." Library provides game sets; beginners welcome.
address: Quince Orchard Library, 15831 Quince Orchard Road, Gaithersburg, MD 20878
